body_markdown:
BOTHELL, Wash. –


[Immunome, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fimmunome.com%2F&esheet=54597761&newsitemid=20260902093802&lan=en-US&anchor=Immunome%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=f598686855b2214050c10ee23c39ef57) (Nasdaq: IMNM), a clinical-stage targeted oncology company focused on developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies, today announced that Immunome management will present at H.C. Wainwright’s 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on September 14, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET.


Interested parties can access the live audio webcast of the presentation from the Investor Relations section of the company’s website at[www.immunome.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fimmunome.com%2F&esheet=54597761&newsitemid=20260902093802&lan=en-US&anchor=www.immunome.com&index=2&md5=30996d3aff2d97b65894c2be5f432d7e) . The webcast replay will be available after the conclusion of the live presentation for approximately 30 days.


**About Immunome, Inc.**


Immunome is a clinical-stage targeted oncology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies. We are advancing an innovative portfolio of therapeutics, supported by a leadership team with deep experience in the design, development, and commercialization of cutting-edge therapies, including antibody-drug conjugates. Our pipeline includes varegacestat, an investigational gamma secretase inhibitor for which an NDA has been accepted by the U.S. FDA; IM-1021, a clinical-stage ROR1 ADC; IM-1617, a clinical-stage solid tumor ADC; and IM-3050, a clinical-stage FAP-targeted radioligand therapy. We are also advancing a broad portfolio of early-stage ADCs pursuing undisclosed solid tumor targets.
